# CaptionRush

> CaptionRush is a free browser tool that turns the speech in a video into animated, word-by-word captions for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Upload a clip, check the captions, pick a style and download an MP4 with burned-in captions, or SRT/VTT subtitle files. Free during the beta, no account needed.

CaptionRush (formerly Capivo) is made in Switzerland by Jonas Treier (sole proprietorship web&meh) in Frick, Aargau. It is currently in beta.

## Key facts

- What it does: automatic captions/subtitles for short vertical videos (Reels, TikToks, Shorts).
- Transcription: server-side with the Whisper large-v3 speech model (via Groq), followed by an AI proofreading pass for names, places and dialect words. Nothing to download for the user.
- Languages: 16 spoken languages with automatic detection: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi. The language can also be set manually.
- German: fully supported. Swiss German and other strong dialects can still contain mistakes and should be checked in the editor before export.
- Caption styles: 24, from bold karaoke-style captions to calm subtitles, with word-by-word highlighting.
- Editor: fix words and timing, "Names & terms" field for tricky names and brand terms, templates, optional AI emphasis (keywords, emojis, zoom), suggested post caption and hashtags.
- Export: MP4 with burned-in captions (1080p by default, no watermark), SRT, VTT and a plain TXT transcript.
- Privacy: only the audio track is sent for transcription; the video stays on the device and the MP4 is rendered locally in the browser. Audio and transcripts are not stored on CaptionRush servers.
- Devices: runs in desktop and mobile browsers (including iPhone and Android); no app or plugin to install.
- Price: free during the beta, no account needed; an email address is asked before the first video download. Paid plans Creator (planned $7.99/month, 300 transcription minutes) and Pro (planned $14.99/month, 1,200 transcription minutes) are announced as "coming soon" and are not available yet.

## FAQ highlights

- How do I add captions to Instagram Reels, TikTok or YouTube Shorts? Upload the video on the page, check the captions, pick a style and download the MP4. The captions are burned into the video, so the file can be posted as it is.
- Is it free? Is there a watermark? Free during the beta, no account needed; MP4 export has no watermark. An email is asked (optionally, you can skip it) before the first video download. Once paid plans exist: Free has no watermark for the first 2 videos each day, from the 3rd video per day a small watermark appears; paid plans never have one.
- Do I need to install anything? No, it runs in the browser.
- Is my video uploaded? No, only the audio track is sent for transcription.
